moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect is rank 2 or higher.

moves.name: How Interesting!
moves.description: Raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by 3 stat ranks.

passives.name: Blazing Sunlight Transformation
passives.description: Restores 1 MP of the user’s moves that have the Berry effect tag when it uses Sitrus Berry while the weather is sunny. Has a chance (50%) of restoring 1 MP of the user’s moves that have the Berry effect tag when it uses Sitrus Berry while the weather is not sunny.

passives.name: Advantageous Abundance
passives.description: Grants all of the following effects when the user uses Sitrus Berry: Makes opponents target the user for a short time. Applies the Take Next "All" Move effect to the user. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks.

passives.name: Max Move: Dragon Zone
passives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Dragon Zone after using the user’s max move. (A Dragon Zone powers up Dragon-type attacks.)
